# f5xc_fast_acl_rule (Resource)

Fast ACL rule Fast ACL rule Rule consists of following: 1. Protocol to match from packet 2. List of source IP prefixes or a reference to IP prefix set, to which source IP in packet should belong to. 3. Action to be applied if above fields match `fast_acl` object would refer to `fast_acl_rule`, both objects together provides a five tuple {destination ip, destination port, source ip, source port, protocol} to match and an action to be applied. In five tuple rule provides source IP, source port and action Supported actions are: - Allow - Deny - Policer - Rate limit using policer defined - Protocol Policer - Rate limit for various protocol type. Supported protocols are tcp, udp, icmp, dns

To get more information about f5xc_fast_acl_rule, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/fast-acl-rule)
